```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load_packages}
library(graphicalMCP)
```

### Example 3

#### Initial graph
```{r initial_graph}
hypotheses <- c(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0)
transitions <- rbind(c(0, 0.5, 0.5, 0),
                     c(0.5, 0, 0, 0.5),
                     c(0, 1, 0, 0),
                     c(1, 0, 0, 0))
hyp_names <- c("H1", "H2", "H3", "H4")
g <- graph_create(hypotheses,
                  transitions,
                  hyp_names)
plot(g, vertex.size = 30, margins = c(1,1,1,1))
```

#### Updated graph
```{r updated_graph}
updated_g <- graph_update(g, delete = c(F, T, F, F))
plot(updated_g, vertex.size = 30, margins = c(1,1,1,1))
```

#### Testing
```{r testing}
p_value <- c(0.018, 0.01, 0.105, 0.006)
test_results <- graph_test_shortcut(g, p = p_value, alpha = 0.025)
test_results$outputs$rejected
test_results$outputs$adjusted_p
```

#### Stepwise decisions
```{r stepwise_decisions}
test_results <- graph_test_shortcut(g, p = p_value, alpha = 0.025,test_values=T)
test_results$test_values$results
```

#### Rejection sequences
```{r rejection_sequences}
graph_rejection_orderings(test_results)$valid_orderings
```

#### Power
```{r power}
set.seed(1234)
power_results <- graph_calculate_power(g,
                                       sim_n = 1e6,
                                       sim_corr = diag(4),
                                       power_marginal = c(0.9, 0.9, 0.8, 0.8))
power_results$power$power_local
```

#### Success objectives
```{r success_objectives}
set.seed(1234)
success_fns <- list(# Prob to reject both hypotheses for either dose
  `(H1andH3)or(H2andH4)` = function(x) (x[1] & x[3]) | (x[2] & x[4]))
power_results <- graph_calculate_power(g,
                                       sim_n = 1e6,
                                       sim_corr = diag(4),
                                       power_marginal = c(0.9, 0.9, 0.8, 0.8),
                                       sim_success= success_fns)
power_results$power$power_success
```

### Example based on the CANTOS trial

#### Initial graph
```{r cantos_example_initial_graph}
hypotheses <- c(0.2, 0.4, 0.4, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
epsilon <- 1e-5
transitions <- rbind(H11=c(0, 0.45, 0.25, 0.27, 0, 0, 0.03, 0, 0),
                     H21=c(0.07, 0, 0.63, 0, 0.27, 0, 0, 0.03, 0),
                     H31=c(0.07, 0.13, 0, 0, 0, 0.72, 0, 0, 0.08),
                     H12=c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0),
                     H22=c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0),
                     H32=c(0, epsilon, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1 - epsilon),
                     H13=c(0, epsilon, 0, 1 - epsilon, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                     H23=c(0, 0, epsilon, 0, 1 - epsilon, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                     H33=c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0))
g <- graph_create(hypotheses, transitions)
plot_layout <- rbind(c(0.15, 0.5), c(0.65, 0.5), c(1.15, 0.5),
                     c(0, 0), c(0.5, 0), c(1, 0),
                     c(0.3, 0), c(0.8, 0), c(1.3, 0))
plot(g,
     layout = plot_layout,
     eps = epsilon,
     edge_curves = c(pairs = 0.5),
     vertex.size = 15,
     rescale = FALSE,
     xlim = c(-0.2, 1.5),
     ylim = c(-0.3, 0.9))
```

#### Updated objectives
```{r cantos_example_updated_graph}
updated_g <- graph_update(g, delete = c(T, F, F, F, F, F, F, F, F))
  plot_layout <- rbind(
    c(0.15, 0.8), c(0.75, 0.8), c(1.35, 0.8),
    c(0, 0),      c(0.6, 0),    c(1.15, 0),
    c(0.3, 0),    c(0.9, 0),    c(1.5, 0)
  )
  plot(updated_g,
       layout = plot_layout,
       eps = epsilon,
       edge_curves = c(pairs = 0.3),
       vertex.size = 15,
       edge.label.cex = 0.7,
       rescale = FALSE,
       xlim = c(-0.2, 1.7),
       ylim = c(-0.3, 1.1))
```

#### Testing
```{r cantos_exaple_testing}
set.seed(1234)
corr <- matrix(0.4, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
diag(corr) <- 1
pvalues <- c(0.0314, 0.02075, 0.30, 0.004, 0.005, 0.12, 0.006, 0.02, 0.07) / 2
test_results <- graph_test_closure(g,
                                   p = pvalues,
                                   alpha = 0.0245,
                                   test_groups= list(1:3, 4:9),
                                   test_types= c("parametric", "bonferroni"),
                                   test_corr= list(corr, NA))
test_results$outputs$rejected
test_results$outputs$adjusted_p
```

#### Closed test
```{r cantos_example_closed_test}
set.seed(1234)
closed_test <- graph_test_closure(g,
                                  p = pvalues,
                                  alpha = 0.0245,
                                  test_groups = list(1:3, 4:9),
                                  test_types = c("parametric", "bonferroni"),
                                  test_corr = list(corr, NA),
                                  test_values = TRUE)
subset(closed_test$test_values$results, Intersection == "011111111")
```

#### Power
```{r cantos_example_power}
set.seed(1234)
marginal_power <- c(0.85, 0.85, 0.85, 0.75, 0.75, 0.75, 0.65, 0.65, 0.65)
corr_sim <-matrix(0.5, nrow = 9, ncol = 9)
diag(corr_sim) <- 1
success_fns <- list(`AllPE` = function(x) x[1] & x[2] & x[3])
power_results <- graph_calculate_power(g,
                                       alpha = 0.0245,
                                       sim_corr = corr_sim,
                                       sim_n = 1e5,
                                       power_marginal = c(marginal_power),
                                       test_groups= list(1:3, 4:9),
                                       test_types= c("parametric", "bonferroni"),
                                       test_corr= list(corr, NA),
                                       sim_success = success_fns)
power_results$power
```

#### Testing with Simes
```{r cantos_exaple_testing_simes}
set.seed(1234)
test_results <- graph_test_closure(g,
                                   p = pvalues,
                                   alpha = 0.0245,
                                   test_groups= list(1:3, c(4, 7), c(5, 8), c(6, 9)),
                                   test_types= c("parametric", "simes", "simes", "simes"),
                                   test_corr= list(corr, NA, NA, NA))
test_results$outputs$rejected
test_results$outputs$adjusted_p
```

#### Closed test with Simes
```{r cantos_example_closed_test_simes}
set.seed(1234)
closed_test <- graph_test_closure(g,
                                  p = pvalues,
                                  alpha = 0.0245,
                                  test_groups = list(1:3, c(4, 7), c(5, 8), c(6, 9)),
                                  test_types = c("parametric", "simes", "simes", "simes"),
                                  test_corr = list(corr, NA, NA, NA),
                                  test_values= TRUE)
subset(closed_test$test_values$results, Intersection == "011111111")
```

#### Power with Simes
```{r cantos_example_power_simes}
set.seed(1234)
power_results <- graph_calculate_power(g,
                                       alpha = 0.0245,
                                       sim_corr = corr_sim,
                                       sim_n = 1e5,
                                       power_marginal = c(marginal_power),
                                       test_groups = list(1:3, c(4, 7), c(5, 8), c(6, 9)),
                                       test_types= c("parametric", "simes", "simes", "simes"),
                                       test_corr= list(corr, NA, NA, NA),
                                       sim_success = success_fns)
power_results$power
```
